visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins in a workshop environment with shelves of supplies in the background. A man with a top-knot hairstyle and a white face mask (Tai Chih-yuan) talks to a master craftsman wearing glasses and a gray apron. A young woman with a white beret stands nearby. The lighting is bright and even. (2) Close-up shots follow, focusing on the master's gloved hands holding a white silicone-like mold. He points out the realistic 'duck skin' texture inside. The camera captures small, yellowish-white solid pieces resembling meat. (3) The scene shifts to the craftsmen painting the food models. One person uses a fine brush to apply brownish paint to the 'duck meat' pieces within the mold. Later, the woman uses a professional airbrush to spray a light brown color onto a long piece of 'meat' held with tweezers. (4) The final sequence shows the assembly. Plastic white rice grains are poured from a metal bowl into a white ceramic bowl. The master carefully places the painted duck meat slices on top of the rice. The camera provides multiple extreme close-ups of the finished 'Duck Meat Rice' model, highlighting the glistening, realistic texture of the meat and skin. The characters look at the camera, with Tai expressing surprise at the realism.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Slogan]: 一日美食模型製作. [Logo]: 木曜4超玩. [Subtitle]: 接下來我們可以做什麼了. (2) [Variety]: 鴨肉飯. (3) [Variety]: 突然跳級?! [Subtitle]: 直接就做鴨肉飯. (4) [Subtitle]: 上面還有點點. 點點那個就是雞皮疙瘩. (5) [Logo]: KAKUKOW FOOD SAMPLE. [Subtitle]: 烤起來就會像這樣. 就一塊是帶皮的. 就放在那一碗的中間那邊. (6) [Subtitle]: 原來是這樣啊. 有一個訣竅在. 都是技術. 把它畫進去那個雞皮疙瘩裡面. (7) [Subtitle]: 比起手 眼睛先殘. 為什麼沒戴眼鏡過來. (8) [Subtitle]: 這是大量機器壓出來的塑膠米. 這要是我不知道的話. 我極有可能跟蛋會炒在一起. (9) [Subtitle]: 你自己看像不像. 我現在還沒有上色哦. 沒有上色我也想吃了. (10) [Subtitle]: 真的很好玩啊. 就是你願意靜下心來慢慢去做. 不是一個浮躁的人可以做得了的事. (11) [Subtitle]: 居然會看到一碗假的東西在那邊流口水是什麼意思. (12) [Subtitle]: 你會被它騙你知道嗎. (13) [Variety]: 史上最合法的詐騙集團.

It highlights the professional skills of the Kakukow Food Sample workshop and aims to entertain through the host's humorous reactions to the high level of realism.
